tools.name: sheets_filter_formula
tools.description: Build a FILTER formula that shows the rows of a range matching 1-3 conditions (equals, contains, starts/ends with, one of, blank, number and date comparisons), optionally sorted and with a "no match" message. Returns the formula and a note.

tools.name: sheets_rank_formula
tools.description: Build a formula that ranks one column, with a choice of tie handling (min: 1,2,2,4; dense: 1,2,2,3; avg: 1,2.5,2.5,4; unique: 1,2,3,4) and optional ranking within a group column. mode "column" fills the whole column from one cell; mode "row" is a per-row formula to drag down.

tools.name: sheets_unique_formula
tools.description: Build a formula for unique values: a UNIQUE list, COUNTUNIQUE, a value/count table, only the repeated values, or only the values that appear once.

tools.name: docs_match_case_replacement
tools.description: Given matched texts and a replacement, return the replacement in the case shape of each match (ALL CAPS, Title Case, First letter, lower). The rule ReplaceKit uses for "Keep the case of each match" in Google Docs.

tools.name: clean_text
tools.description: Run ReplaceKit cleanups on text (up to 50,000 characters), in the order given: double-spaces, space-before-punct, trailing-spaces, empty-paragraphs, line-breaks, nbsp, curly-quotes, straight-quotes. Returns the cleaned text and how many replacements each made.
